issues.summary: Contoso Ltd: API latency in EU region, p95 above 4 s during business hours
issues.description:
Contoso Ltd's Frankfurt workloads see `/v2/orders` and `/v2/inventory` calls take 4 to 6 seconds (p95) between 08:00 and 17:00 CET. Their nightly integration jobs time out and retry. Started around October 26.

**Customer impact**

- Order sync to Contoso's ERP runs late every morning.
- Contoso IT operations reported it; the CIO has escalated.

**Environment**

- Region: EU West (Frankfurt)
- Tenant: contoso-ltd-prod

comments.author: isaiah
comments.body: Contoso's CIO, Lidia Holloway, has escalated this directly. Their renewal is December 31. Can EU Platform pick this up?

comments.author: mei
comments.body: Triage: no owner yet in the EU Platform queue this week. Leaving unassigned for the queue lead.

issues.summary: Contoso Ltd: intermittent SSO login failures (SAML assertion rejected)
issues.description:
About 3% of Contoso Ltd sign-ins fail with `SAML assertion expired` from two subsidiaries' identity providers.

**Environment**

- Tenant: contoso-ltd-prod
- Identity provider: Contoso's Entra ID federation

comments.author: rosa
comments.body: Reproduced. Assertions are rejected when the subsidiary IdP clock is more than 90 seconds ahead. Testing a wider skew tolerance in staging.

issues.summary: Contoso Ltd: EU API gateway timeouts on bulk export endpoint
issues.description:
The EU West gateway returns 504s on `/v2/exports` during Contoso's morning batch window (07:00 to 09:00 CET). Same time window as the latency in INC-40211.

**Environment**

- Region: EU West (Frankfurt)
- Tenant: contoso-ltd-prod

issues.summary: Contoso Pharmaceuticals: report export fails for datasets over 2 GB
issues.description: Contoso Pharmaceuticals (a separate customer from Contoso Ltd) can't export compliance reports larger than 2 GB.

issues.summary: Tailwind Traders: webhook delivery retries in US East
issues.description: Webhook deliveries to Tailwind Traders retry up to three times before succeeding.

issues.summary: Contoso Ltd: elevated latency on EU reporting API
issues.description: Contoso Ltd reporting API calls in EU West took 3 to 5 seconds (p95) after a traffic spike.

comments.author: arjun
comments.body: Root cause: connection pool exhaustion on the EU West gateway. Raised the pool size and added an autoscaling rule. Contoso confirms p95 is back under 400 ms. Resolving.

resolution.description: Work has been completed on this work item.
resolution.name: Done

issues.summary: Contoso Ltd: EU API latency after gateway certificate rotation
issues.description: After the June certificate rotation, Contoso Ltd's EU West API calls slowed to 2 to 3 seconds (p95).

comments.author: arjun
comments.body: TLS session resumption was disabled by the rotation. Re-enabled it on the EU West gateway; latency is back to baseline. Added a check to the rotation runbook.

resolution.description: Work has been completed on this work item.
resolution.name: Done

pages.title: Contoso Ltd – account overview
pages.author: isaiah
pages.body:
Contoso Ltd is a manufacturing group with 14 subsidiaries. Not to be confused with Contoso Pharmaceuticals, a separate customer.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Account executive | Megan Bowen |
| Customer success manager | Isaiah Langer |
| Executive sponsor | Lidia Holloway, CIO |
| Procurement | Daniel Okafor, Head of Procurement |
| Region | EU West (Frankfurt) and US East |
| Contract | $2.4M a year, term ends December 31, 2026 (see Salesforce) |

## Open customer asks

| Ask | Raised | Status | Committed date |
|---|---|---|---|
| **SSO roadmap commitment**: SCIM 2.0 user provisioning and per-subsidiary conditional access for all 14 subsidiaries, in writing with the renewal | Q3 QBR, September 29 | **Open** | None yet |
| Quarterly EU usage report | Q2 QBR | Done | Delivered monthly since July |

## Health

- Usage up 22% year over year.
- Support: two EU latency incidents in 2026, both resolved by Arjun Kumar (INC-39412, INC-39750).

pages.author: isaiah
pages.body:
Approved by Product leadership on October 20, 2026.

| Capability | Target | Committable to customers |
|---|---|---|
| SCIM 2.0 user and group provisioning (GA) | March 31, 2027 | **Yes** |
| Per-subsidiary conditional access policies | Q2 2027 (by June 30, 2027) | **Yes, as a target quarter** |
